title: Tunisian Vegan Frittata
description: A vegan twist on the classic Italian dish, this Tunisian Vegan Frittata is a flavorful and satisfying brunch option. Made with delicate ingredients and no eggs, this recipe is perfect for those who follow a plant-based diet.

ingredients.name: vegan feta cheese (made with tofu and nutritional yeast)

instructions: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the Tunisian olives, hummus, and crumbled tofu frittata.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
Top with chopped arugula and crumbled vegan feta cheese.
Drizzle with lemon juice and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the filling is set and the crust is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
